title: Large gaps between primes
description: Large gaps between consecutive primes. The average gap, and the theorem that for every C > 0 a positive proportion of the gaps p_(n+1) - p_n exceed C log p_n, which answers a question of Erdős and Prachar on the increases of p_n/n. Smooth divisor sums and their averages, with a prime factor through the Bombieri-Vinogradov theorem; the singular series and Gallagher's theorem on its average; correlations of smooth divisor sums by Euler products near the pole of the zeta function; a square of signed divisor sums whose prime mass in an adjacent interval is controlled by neighbouring dimensions; and an alternating choice of test functions that makes this mass arbitrarily small.

units.title: Divisor sums and primes in progressions
The singular series and its average
A square with little prime mass in the next interval

prerequisites: NT-ZETA lessons on Dirichlet series (Euler products, zeta near s = 1), on Chebyshev's and Mertens's estimates, and on the prime number theorem
NT-DIRL lesson on the Bombieri-Vinogradov theorem (Corollary 4.1)
Fourier inversion on the Schwartz space (elliptic-operators-and-boundary-problems, prerequisite bridges, Theorem 1.1)
